_comment: Add these two statements to the mimawsi-deploy policy, then `terraform apply`.
Checked on 2026-09-06: that identity has neither cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm nor
sns:CreateTopic. Both were probed directly and both returned AccessDenied, so
the note in HANDOFF.md saying it holds CloudWatch and SNS is wrong.
In the IAM console, editing a managed policy creates a NEW VERSION. Tick
'Set this new version as the default' or the edit saves and changes nothing —
which is a trap this project has already fallen into once.
Scoped to mimawsi-* names rather than *, so this grant cannot touch alarms or
topics belonging to anything else in the account.
Deliberately absent: budgets:*. A budget forecasts rather than reacting and
would be the better instrument, but it is a larger grant and the metric alarm
closes the unbounded-downside gap today. Add it when this is next revisited.
